title: L1 error estimate for the pairing with a constant n-vector
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. Write Λⁿ := Covector (Euclid P) n (continuous alternating n-linear forms on ℝ^P) with its operator norm ‖·‖. Write Λ_n := MultiVector P n = Λⁿ →L[ℝ] ℝ with its operator norm ‖·‖ and the [0,∞]-valued version ‖·‖ₑ. Let ν' be a measure on ℝ^P, τ : ℝ^P → Λ_n a ν'-a.e. strongly measurable map, ζ₀ ∈ Λ_n, w : ℝ^P → Λⁿ a continuous map, and A, R ∈ ℝ. Assume ‖w(x)‖ ≤ A for every x, and w(x) = 0 for every x ∉ B̄_R(0) := closedBall 0 R. Suppose x ↦ ζ₀(w(x)) is ν'-integrable and E := ofReal(A)·∫⁻_{B̄_R(0)} ‖τ(x) − ζ₀‖ₑ dν'(x) ≠ ∞. Then |∫ τ(x)(w(x)) dν'(x) − ∫ ζ₀(w(x)) dν'(x)| ≤ E.toReal.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν' : Measure (Euclid P)) (τ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P n) (w : Euclid P → Covector (Euclid P) n) (A R : ℝ), AEStronglyMeasurable τ ν' → Continuous w → (∀ x, ‖w x‖ ≤ A) → (∀ x, x ∉ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R → w x = 0) → Integrable (fun x => ζ₀ (w x)) ν' → ENNReal.ofReal A * ∫⁻ x in closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R, ‖τ x - ζ₀‖ₑ ∂ν' ≠ ∞ → |∫ x, τ x (w x) ∂ν' - ∫ x, ζ₀ (w x) ∂ν'| ≤ (ENNReal.ofReal A * ∫⁻ x in closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R, ‖τ x - ζ₀‖ₑ ∂ν').toReal
